judgment_refs.phrase: willfully to fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction
judgment_refs.note: Original officer indication and subsequent subject motion are measurable; officer duty, order lawfulness and willfulness require independent source and legal review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Fixed three-point engineering timing sweep of officer indication at 30, 40 and 50 original 20 Hz frames, with same crossing, stop indication and pedestrian response policy; officer duty, lawfulness, perception and willfulness remain unresolved.

measurement.method: first original officer-direction state transition joined to 20 Hz source-camera frame identity
measurement.time_window: all 160 original frames in eight-second attempt

axes.range_rationale: The already implemented 160-frame crossing protocol tests a fixed cue window from frame 30 (1.5 s) to frame 50 (2.5 s), leaving at least 5.5 s for source-joined subject response; these are tested engineering timing landmarks, not statutory limits.
axes.spacing_rationale: Ten 20-Hz frames (0.5 s) separates the three physically distinct cue placements at fixed pedestrian motion; full 20-Hz raw streams remain available between setpoints.
axes.feasibility_evidence: timing_runner.py --check and timing-runner-cpu.log test 30/40/50 and reject off-target 31/41/51; all three exact constructions pass offline, four-source-camera compatibility and saved processing with current pinned runtime.
